summary: Gitea Release with deploy secrets set publishes APT packages, ISO/source downloads, and the static website in the same run. The deploy-credential check and the website build run before the release is created, so a bad build or a half-set secret stops the run before the tag moves, and the website release id is left to website-ci-deploy.sh's unique timestamp-sha fallback instead of the package version. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Release now publishes static pages with APT and downloads and fails before tagging; the prerequisite no longer implies public clearance for 0.4.3.

api.reason: CI publish wiring only; no Controller/Core API contract change.

state.reason: No durable pool or Controller state; CI and public site artifacts only.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest tests.test_ci_security tests.test_website_hosting tests.test_release_publish; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree — new checks test_deploy_checks_and_website_build_run_before_the_tag_moves and test_website_release_id_is_left_to_the_deploy_script
